name: Causal loop diagram (variables joined by polarised causal links, with the feedback loops they form enumerated and labelled R or B by arithmetic rather than by assertion; .cld — ADP’s own line-oriented text format, adopted after XMILE was rejected for carrying stocks, flows and equations this diagram states none of, and carrying one presentation word of its own, flipped, which bows a link’s arc to the other side of its chord where the automatic side crosses something); causal-loop-diagram (specification removed from the tree; in history before 53f68611)

theory.label: The notation is the established one from system dynamics — polarity on the link, R/B on the loop, strokes across a delayed arrow. What ADP adds is the check: a loop is reinforcing on an even count of negative links and balancing on an odd one, so a stated label is verifiable, and a disagreement is reported rather than corrected. Cycles are enumerated with Johnson’s elementary cycles algorithm, bounded. The self-organizing layout adopts Meyer’s method with every source of randomness replaced by a function of the document and the iteration index
